projects.name: Dokploy
projects.tagline: Deploy and manage applications and databases on your own servers
projects.description: Dokploy is a self-hosted deployment platform for applications and databases. It provides a web interface for Docker-based deployments, domains, logs, scheduled tasks, and server management.

projects.name: Appwrite
projects.tagline: Develop applications with integrated backend services and SDKs
projects.description: Appwrite is a backend platform with authentication, databases, storage, functions, and realtime capabilities. It offers client SDKs and a self-hosting option alongside its managed cloud service.

projects.name: Supabase
projects.tagline: Build application backends around PostgreSQL and integrated services
projects.description: Supabase combines PostgreSQL with authentication, storage, realtime features, and APIs. Its open-source components can be self-hosted, while the company also offers a managed platform.

projects.name: Better Auth
projects.tagline: Add authentication to TypeScript applications with plugins
projects.description: Better Auth is a TypeScript authentication framework with email and password, social sign-in, session handling, and a plugin system. Database adapters and framework integrations support application-specific setups.

projects.name: Prisma
projects.tagline: Query databases with a generated client and schema tooling
projects.description: Prisma ORM provides a schema language, generated database client, and migration tools for JavaScript and TypeScript applications. It helps application developers model data and execute typed database queries.

projects.name: Drizzle ORM
projects.tagline: Write typed SQL queries and manage database schema changes
projects.description: Drizzle ORM is a TypeScript database toolkit with SQL-oriented query APIs and typed schemas. Its companion Drizzle Kit supports schema migrations, and adapters cover PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite.

projects.name: Fastify
projects.tagline: Develop Node.js web services with plugins and schema support
projects.description: Fastify is a Node.js web framework with a plugin architecture and support for schema-based request validation and response serialization. It offers hooks and logging integrations for building web services.

projects.name: Hono
projects.tagline: Build web APIs using standard Request and Response objects
projects.description: Hono is a TypeScript web framework built around web standards. It provides routing and middleware for APIs and web applications across supported JavaScript runtimes, including server and edge environments.

projects.name: Nuxt
projects.tagline: Create Vue applications with integrated rendering and routing
projects.description: Nuxt is a full-stack framework built on Vue. It combines application routing, rendering options, server endpoints, and a module ecosystem to support websites and web applications.

projects.name: Svelte
projects.tagline: Build reactive user interfaces with a component compiler
projects.description: Svelte is a UI framework that compiles declarative components into JavaScript. It combines markup, styles, and reactive logic in components, while SvelteKit provides the wider application framework.

projects.name: Astro
projects.tagline: Build content-focused websites with selective interactivity
projects.description: Astro is a web framework for content-driven sites. Its islands architecture lets developers add interactive components where needed, with support for multiple UI frameworks and server or static rendering.

projects.name: Next.js
projects.tagline: Build React applications with routing and server rendering
projects.description: Next.js is a React framework with file-based routing, server rendering, and tools for building full-stack web applications. It includes development and production workflows plus multiple deployment options.

projects.name: Rollup
projects.tagline: Bundle JavaScript modules for libraries and applications
projects.description: Rollup bundles JavaScript modules into distributable libraries and applications. It supports tree shaking, code splitting, multiple output formats, and a plugin ecosystem for custom build workflows.

projects.name: Vite Task
projects.tagline: Run monorepo tasks with caching and dependency-aware scheduling
projects.description: Vite Task powers vp run in Vite+. It coordinates tasks across workspace packages, respects dependency order, and supports caching to avoid repeating work when task inputs have not changed.

projects.name: Vite+
projects.tagline: One toolchain for developing, checking, testing, and building the web
projects.description: Vite+ combines development, builds, testing, linting, formatting, library packaging, and task execution behind the vp command. It integrates the Vite ecosystem with runtime and package manager workflows.

projects.name: Oxc
projects.tagline: High-performance JavaScript and TypeScript tools written in Rust
projects.description: Oxc is a collection of JavaScript and TypeScript tools written in Rust, including a parser, linter, formatter, transformer, minifier, and resolver.

projects.name: Vitest
projects.tagline: Test JavaScript and TypeScript with a Vite-powered workflow
projects.description: Vitest is a Vite-powered testing framework for JavaScript and TypeScript. It offers watch mode, assertions, mocking, snapshots, code coverage, and browser testing, with support for reusing application configuration.

projects.name: tsdown
projects.tagline: Build JavaScript and TypeScript libraries with less configuration
projects.description: tsdown is a library bundler powered by Rolldown and Oxc. It combines JavaScript output and TypeScript declaration generation with library-focused defaults and support for multiple module formats.

projects.name: Rolldown
projects.tagline: A Rust-powered bundler with Rollup-compatible APIs
projects.description: Rolldown bundles JavaScript and TypeScript with a Rust-based engine and familiar Rollup APIs. It supports application and library builds and provides the bundling foundation for Vite and tsdown.

projects.name: Vite
projects.tagline: A fast development server and build tool for modern web apps
projects.description: Vite provides a development server with fast hot module replacement and a production build pipeline for modern web applications. Its plugin ecosystem supports popular frameworks and custom integrations.
